def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    
    if not car_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center and then by their vertical center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: (p.horizontal_center, p.vertical_center))
    
    # Filter out cars that are not in the right part of the image
    right_cars = [car for car in car_patches if car.right > image_patch.width / 2]
    
    # Further filter out cars that are not moving towards the top of the image
    moving_towards_top = [car for car in right_cars if car.upper < image_patch.height / 2]
    
    return moving_towards_top
